$comment: email-communication-intelligence-r1 task 041 (FR-13 / NFR-07 blocking merge gate) — the attachment-grounded action-extraction eval family, joined to the SAME Category=GoldenUtteranceEval merge gate via AttachmentActionEvalTests.cs (identical net-new-family pattern as the create-task-from-email / triage-email / email-propose families in this directory — no shared golden-utterances.json edit, no CI-YAML change; the trait IS the registration). No new ConsumerType is introduced — FR-13 REUSES the create-task-from-email Action + the ICommunicationCreateTaskAi facade + the IActionSeam.CreateTaskAsync create leg (the P2LoopInjection ConsumerTypes.All full-catalog forcing function is already satisfied by task 040's GU-140). What this family proves MECHANICALLY (no live model): (1) attachment-only-locator — an action present ONLY in an attachment is machine-verified to the attachment + a CODE-DERIVED page via the REAL AttachmentActionGate.VerifyAgainstAttachment (this is the NFR-07 heart: an action stated only in an attachment, cited to that attachment); (2) cost-gate — the deterministic NFR-08 pre-filter flags action-bearing attachments and skips inert ones via the REAL AttachmentActionGate.IsLikelyActionTrigger; (3) reuse-not-fork — no new Action / facade / ConsumerType / create mechanism (grep-verifiable); (4) deadline-confirm — a deadline-bearing attachment candidate reuses the DueDate.HasValue -> human-confirm branch (NFR-06/ADR-015). All cases are channel:'event' (invoked off the Communication enrichment path, no chat/loop projection).

cases.utterance: [email-attachment-action] an action stated ONLY in an attachment (not the subject/body) is machine-verified to the attachment and cited to a code-derived page
cases.notes: The NFR-07 heart: AttachmentActionGate.VerifyAgainstAttachment locates the verbatim cited span in a specific attachment page and returns (present:true, page:N) — the page is DERIVED by locating the span, never asserted by the model. A span present only in the email body (not the attachment) returns present:false (attachment-scoped, strictly stronger than the shipped merged-blob check). Proven against the REAL gate.

cases.utterance: [email-attachment-action] NFR-08 — only attachments whose text carries an action-trigger signal are sent for an LLM extraction pass; inert attachments are skipped
cases.notes: AttachmentActionGate.IsLikelyActionTrigger returns true for action-bearing text ('please countersign', 'file no later than') and false for an inert reference attachment (an org chart, a revenue summary) — the deterministic cost gate that bounds LLM spend. Proven against the REAL gate.

cases.notes: Grep-verifiable structural proof: CommunicationEnrichmentService's attachment step calls _createTaskAi.ExtractAsync and _actionSeam.CreateTaskAsync (the SAME reused primitives as Job C); there is NO new infra/dataverse/actions/*attachment*.json Action file; ConsumerTypes.cs adds NO attachment-action routed constant (the reused routing consumer is EmailCreateTask). §11 reuse-maximal.
